title: Appointed as Assistant
original: If there's nothing to do, I'll... be here.
original_zh: 没什么事的话……我会在这里安静待着。
translation: Если нечего делать... я просто побуду здесь.

title: Talk 1
original: Since when was I in the Activity Room...? Since... before you came in...
original_zh: 我是什么时候出现的？在你进入活动室之前，我就在了……
translation: С какой это поры я в комнате отдыха...? Я была здесь ещё до того, как ты вошла...

title: Talk 2
original: Vegetables... could grow well here.

title: Talk 3
original: You want me to play the guitar? Okay.
original_zh: 希望我弹吉他吗？知道了。
translation: Хочешь, чтобы я поиграла на гитаре? Хорошо.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I got this fragrance from Perfumer-san. She says Gloria uses it too.
original_zh: 这是调香师小姐给我的香水。葛罗莉亚也在用的。
translation: Это духи, которые мне дала Парфюмер. Говорит, Глория тоже ими пользуется.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Heheh... It's nice to... meet expectations.
original_zh: 嘿嘿……回应了大家的期待的感觉，还不坏。

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: So you... also waver, and can't make up your mind... I... do that a lot...
original_zh: 即使是博士你，也会有犹豫不决的时候吗？我也经常这样……
translation: Значит, даже ты... колеблешься и не можешь решиться... Я... часто так делаю...

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Saki once said... we're all 'badgers in the same hole'.
original_zh: 祥说过，我们都是“一丘之貉”……
translation: Саки как-то сказала... что мы все «из одной стаи»...

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Here, nobody recognizes... Minami-chan and Ta-kun...
original_zh: 这里，谁都不认识森南和阿隆……
translation: Здесь никто не знает... Минами-тян и Та-куна...

title: Idle
original: Did I wake you up? Sorry.

title: Onboard
original: Mutsumi Wakaba... Nice to meet you.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I can tell... this isn't just for show. These people, they really died.
original_zh: 我看得出来，这些不是表演，它们真的死掉了。
translation: Я вижу... это не спектакль. Они и правда умерли.

title: Promotion 1
original: I need... more practice...
original_zh: 还需要，更加努力地练习……

title: Promotion 2
original: You're... praising me...

title: Added to Squad
original: Okay.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I think... Saki should be better...
translation: Я думаю... Саки подошла бы больше...

title: Depart
original: Let's get started.

title: Begin Operation
original: Enemies... they're coming.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: I'm... ready.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: I'm prepared.

title: Deployment 1
original: I've got no... choice...

title: Deployment 2
original: I can't... fail.

title: In Battle 1
original: I'll try...

title: In Battle 2
original: These enemies aren't all that scary.
original_zh: 这些敌人也没有那么恐怖。
translation: Эти враги не такие уже страшные.

title: In Battle 3
original: Just don't... think at all...

title: In Battle 4
original: Just do it like I practiced.

title: 4-star Result
original: Thank goodness.

title: 3-star Result
original: I didn't... fail this time.
translation: В этот раз... я не ошиблась.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Thank you for... covering for me...

title: Operation Failure
original: I... messed things up again...

title: Assigned to Facility
original: I'll be... right here.

title: Tap
original: What is it?

title: Trust Tap
original: I'm practicing.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: I was on stage just now... No, not Ave Mujica. The Rhodes Island play. I was a tree.
original_zh: 刚才我在舞台上参加了表演。不，并不是Ave Mujica的演出，是罗德岛大家一起的戏剧。扮演了一棵树。
translation: Я сейчас была на сцене... Нет, не Ave Mujica. Общий спектакль Родоса. Я играла дерево.

title: Greeting
original: Doctor. I didn't have any nightmares, last night... What about you?
original_zh: 博士。昨晚我没做噩梦，您呢？
translation: Доктор. Сегодня ночью мне не снились кошмары... А вам?

title: Birthday
original: Happy... birthday. This is… your present.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: It's so lively outside. Are you sure you're not going...? You're staying in? Okay.
original_zh: 外面很热闹，你不去加入他们吗？你就在这里？……好的。
translation: На улице так весело. Ты точно не пойдёшь?.. Остаёшься здесь?.. Хорошо.
